> A small electric motor that I design and build from scratch. A 3D-printed rotor carries two neodymium magnets, and a coil of  enamelled copper wire sits next to its path. A Hall sensor detects each magnet as it passes,so the coil pushes the magnet and keeps the rotor spinning. The coil is protected by a flyback diode. I design the schematic in KiCad and the rotor, the coil bobbin and the base in Onshape, and I will build and test it on week 10.
